misc: Bags Miura irons and is rumoured to sleep with them.
biography: Miso occupies a legendary and fiercely contested position within the illustrious chronicles of the Hector Trophée, bringing his exceptional golfing prowess from the immaculate fairways of Hirsala Golf to the esteemed pair competition across ten distinct editions. Characterized by a remarkably eccentric disposition away from the links, this dedicated competitor possesses an intensely devotional attachment to his equipment, proudly bagging a set of exquisite Miura irons that he reportedly tucks into bed beside him every night like cherished members of his own family.

Beyond his nocturnal habits with forged steel, Miso has etched his name permanently into the tournament's record books through stellar competitive achievements. He has tasted the ultimate glory of lifting the coveted Hector Trophée on one memorable occasion, triumphantly securing the prized team silverware. While the individual accolades represented by the Victor Trophy have thus far remained outside his personal collection, his ongoing involvement in the vibrant community surrounding the event ensures that his compelling competitive journey remains wide open, leaving admirers in eager anticipation of his next masterclass on the course.
